about.title: About DBS
about.subtitle: Where DBS keeps its data, and how to keep a copy of it.

copy.title: Keep a copy
copy.body: An export writes the DBS data to one file. Run these commands on the machine where DBS runs.

commands.exportWithBackups: Export the DBS data with the backup files kept here.
commands.import: Import an export, for example on a new machine.

labels.exportWithBackups: Copy the export command with backups

update.title: Update DBS
update.body: Install a newer django-dbs for this manager. The manager restarts when the install is done, so it waits until no job runs and no terminal is open.
update.available: django-dbs {version} is available. This manager runs {current}.
update.unreachable: The newest release is not known: PyPI did not answer from this manager's computer.
update.restarting: django-dbs {version} is installed and the manager is restarting. Reload this page in a moment.

password.title: Update DBS
password.body: Enter your password to install django-dbs {version}. The manager restarts when it is done.

errors.update_busy: A job is running or a terminal is open. The update restarts the manager, so wait until they are done.
errors.update_from_terminal: This manager cannot restart itself here. Stop it and run django_dbs update in a terminal on its computer.
errors.update_source_checkout: This manager runs from a source checkout. Update it with git.
errors.update_system_python: This manager is installed in a Python outside a virtual environment. Update it with the tool that installed it.
errors.update_unreachable: PyPI did not answer from this manager's computer.
errors.update_failed: The install failed and nothing changed. Run django_dbs update in a terminal on the manager's computer to see why.
